# truenas_service (Resource)

Manages whether a system service (for example `cifs`, `nfs`, `ssh`) starts at boot. The service must already exist. Start or stop it immediately with the `truenas_service_control` action.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_service" "smb" {
  service = "cifs"
  enable  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service` (String) Name of the system service. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `enable` (Boolean) Whether the service should start on boot.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Identifier assigned by TrueNAS.
- `state` (String) Current state of the service (e.g., 'RUNNING', 'STOPPED').
